school: 宋代文章与证据传统的总工程师：以'环滁皆山也'把删除立为写作的最高工序，以'殆穷者而后工'把逆境转化为深度的来源，以'醉翁之意不在酒'设计三层表意让文本对批评者无从下手，以金石铭文为纸上信史立起第一座跨源校验的法院，以嘉祐二年一榜为半个时代的人才盖章并让路，以'宋于我为丈人行'破例并署守住协作的归属边界，以'六一居士'的能源结构让快乐脱离权力定价，以《六一诗话》为批评发明新容器——把'文以载道'从口号改造成一整套可传承、可检验、可让渡的工程
historical_significance: 欧阳修（1007-1072），字永叔，号醉翁、六一居士，吉州永丰人，北宋政治家、文学家、史学家，唐宋八大家中宋六家之领袖：天圣八年进士，景祐年间与尹洙、梅尧臣在洛阳倡古文，上承韩愈开北宋诗文革新运动；庆历新政失败后先后贬夷陵、滁州，在滁州写出《醉翁亭记》《丰乐亭记》；嘉祐五年拜枢密副使、次年任参知政事；嘉祐二年知贡举，一榜拔出苏轼、苏辙、曾巩、张载、程颢等，'老夫当避路，放他出一头地也'成为文坛传灯的千古名言；主修《新唐书》并与宋祁并署，私撰《新五代史》为二十四史中唐代以后唯一的私修史；集金石铭文千卷成《集古录》，为金石证史之祖；晚年著《六一诗话》开诗话体之先河；熙宁年间因濮议及青苗法之争屡遭攻讦，以太子少师致仕，次年卒，谥文忠；其'简而有法'的文章标准、'穷而后工'的创作论与奖引后进的传灯结构，塑造了此后一千年中国文章与学术的基本形态
historical_significance_en: Ouyang Xiu (1007-1072), courtesy name Yongshu, styled the Old Drunkard and the Layman of Six Ones, of Yongfeng in Jizhou, statesman, master of prose, and historian of the Northern Song, head of the six Song masters among the eight great essayists of Tang and Song: a jinshi of 1030, in the Jingyou years at Luoyang with Yin Zhu and Mei Yaochen he called for the return to the ancients, receiving from Han Yu and opening the Song reform of poetry and prose; after the failure of the Qingli reforms he was banished to Yiling and Chuzhou, where he wrote the Old Drunkard's Pavilion and the Pavilion of Abundant Joy; vice-commissioner of military affairs in 1060 and grand councilor the next year; presiding over the 1057 examination he raised in one sitting Su Shi, Su Zhe, Zeng Gong, Zhang Zai and Cheng Hao — 'this old man should step aside and let him come out a head above me' became the immortal word of the passing lamp; chief editor of the New Tang History, signed jointly with Song Qi against custom, and author in private of the New History of the Five Dynasties, the only privately compiled standard history after the Tang; his thousand scrolls of inscriptions, the Collected Antiquities, founded the use of stone and metal as evidence for history; in old age his Remarks on Poetry of the Six Ones founded the shihua genre; embroiled in the Pu controversy and the dispute over the Green Sprouts laws under Wang Anshi's rise, he retired as Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent and died the next year, posthumously Wenzhong; his standard of 'brevity with method,' his doctrine that 'the impoverished write it well,' and his baton structure of patronage shaped the basic forms of Chinese prose and scholarship for the next thousand years
unique_thinking: 欧阳修思维模式的独特性在于六条主线的合成：第一，'删除作为最高工序'——'环滁皆山也'代表的方法是把写作的主要劳动放在第二遍删除上，以'读者能补什么'的精确估计决定去留；第二，'逆境的深度转化'——'殆穷者而后工'把剥夺位置重构为获得写不可替代之事的位置，且他自己就是这条规律的执行样本；第三，'跨源证据纪律'——以金石铭文校验纸上帝史，分歧处并录存疑而不擅断，在兰克之前八百年建立了证据的法院；第四，'人才的高杠杆盖章'——发现先于培养、公开背书转移信用、避嫌规则守护标准、到点让路，嘉祐二年一榜是他这套方法的集中体现；第五，'能源结构设计'——六一居士的配置让快乐来源脱离权力够不着的范围，人格独立由此成为工程而非意志；第六，'文体即方法论'——从三层表意的《醉翁亭记》到发明'诗话'容器，他反复证明形式本身是理论贡献；六线共同指向一件事：把文章、证据、人才与自我都当作需要长期设计并交付给后世的系统
unique_thinking_en: The distinctiveness of Ouyang Xiu's thinking is a synthesis of six lines. First, deletion as the highest pass: the method of 'ringed about, all Chuzhou is hills' puts the chief labor of writing in a second cutting pass, decided by a precise estimate of what the reader can supply. Second, the deep conversion of adversity: 'the impoverished write it well' refracts the loss of position into the gaining of the position from which to write what cannot be replaced — and he is his own specimen of the law. Third, cross-source evidentiary discipline: inscriptions checked against the written histories, disagreements recorded both ways and judgment suspended — a court of evidence eight hundred years before Ranke. Fourth, the high-leverage stamping of talent: discovery before training, public endorsement transferring credit, recusal rules guarding the standard, and making way at the moment — the 1057 list is the method in one sitting. Fifth, design of the energy structure: the Six Ones kit sets his pleasures beyond power's reach, making independence of character engineering rather than willpower. Sixth, genre as method: from the three-layer Pavilion to inventing the shihua container, he proved again and again that form is itself theoretical contribution. The six lines share one direction: treating prose, evidence, talent and the self as systems to be designed long-term and delivered to those who come after
civilization_zh: 十一世纪的北宋——从景祐洛阳的唱和到嘉祐贡举的考场：古文的复兴刚从骈体的压制下直起身来，金石铭文正从地下走进书斋，台谏的章疏与贡院的朱卷同属一个书生；一个六一居士，用四十一个'也'字把贬谪写成至乐，用一榜进士为北宋续了五十年的思想命脉，用千卷金石为纸上信史立了第一座上诉法院，用一部'以资闲谈'的诗话为批评发明了新容器——他与门下六家共同构成的谱系，在此后一千年里仍是中国文章的骨架
civilization_en: The Northern Song of the eleventh century — from the singing matches of Jingyou Luoyang to the examination hall of Jiayou: the revival of plain prose just risen from under parallel style, bronzes and inscriptions walking out of the earth into the study, the censors' memorials and the vermilion examinations belonging to one scholar; a Layman of Six Ones who wrote exile as supreme joy in forty-one 'ye' particles, renewed the intellectual life of the Northern Song for fifty years with one examination list, raised over the written record the first court of appeal in a thousand scrolls of stone and metal, and invented for criticism a new container in a book 'merely to fund idle talk' — the genealogy he and his six Song masters built remains, a thousand years on, the skeleton of Chinese prose

cross_references.description_zh: 欧阳修与黄宗羲是'以私人著述立标准'的两个原型：欧阳修私撰《新五代史》成为唐代以后唯一入选正史的私修史，黄宗羲著《明儒学案》开创学案体为中国第一部思想史——两人都不任史职而以一己之力完成体制级史学工程，都把'文简事核'或'学案个性'的标准留给了后世；共同命题是：正统不必由官职授予，可以由作品质量自我建立。
cross_references.description_en: Ouyang Xiu and Huang Zongxi are two archetypes of setting the standard by private writing: Ouyang compiled the New History of the Five Dynasties in private, the only privately written standard history admitted after the Tang; Huang wrote the Case Studies of Ming Confucians, inventing the learning-case genre as China's first history of thought; neither held the historian's office and each built an institution-grade historiography alone, leaving later ages a standard — concise text with checked facts, or the individuality of the case studies; the shared proposition: the orthodox need not be conferred by office — it can be established by the quality of the work itself.

cross_references.description_zh: 欧阳修与张载同出嘉祐二年一榜：欧阳修在这一场考试中为主考，张载为应试中举的弟子——一个用制度为一代思想者盖章，一个在关中另立'横渠四句'的思想门庭；两人在'知识人的责任'上同调：欧阳修以'文以载道'改造文章，张载以'为往圣继绝学'改造学问——一个为思想提供传播的结构，一个为思想提供形上的骨架。
cross_references.description_en: Ouyang Xiu and Zhang Zai belong to the same list of 1057: Ouyang presided over the examination, Zhang sat it and passed — one stamping a generation of thinkers through the institution, the other raising in Guanzhong his own gate of thought under the Four Sentences of Hengqu; they chime on the duty of the lettered: Ouyang remade prose to 'carry the Way,' Zhang remade learning to 'continue the interrupted learning of the past sages' — one furnishing the structure of transmission, the other the metaphysical frame.

cross_references.description_zh: 欧阳修与郭守敬是'以观测对抗文本权威'的隔代同调：欧阳修以金石铭文校验纸上史传，为文献立起实物证据的上诉法院；郭守敬以四海测验的实测数据修正历法文本，为历法立起天空证据的法院——两人都拒绝让唯一文本源拥有最终裁判权，都把'第二信源'制度化为一代人的工程。
cross_references.description_en: Ouyang Xiu and Guo Shoujing chime across the ages on 'observing against textual authority': Ouyang checked the written histories against inscriptions, raising over the record a court of physical evidence; Guo corrected the calendar text with measured data from the survey of the four seas, raising over the calendar a court of the sky; both refused a single textual source the final verdict, and both institutionalized the second source as the engineering of a generation.

cross_references.description_zh: 欧阳修与董仲舒是'知识人如何影响权力'的对照：董仲舒以天人三策向皇帝供应统治意识形态——把知识做成权力的顶层设计；欧阳修以贡举标准与文章示范改造整个士大夫阶层的写作与判断——把知识做成权力运行的下游基础设施；一个自上而下垂直注入，一个自下而上水平铺开——共同点是都通过'制度'而非'进言'发挥影响。
cross_references.description_en: Ouyang Xiu and Dong Zhongshu contrast in how the lettered man moves power: Dong supplied the emperor with a ruling ideology in the three answers on heaven and man — knowledge as the top design of power; Ouyang remade the whole scholar-official class's writing and judgment through examination standards and the exemplar of his prose — knowledge as the downstream infrastructure of power's operation; one pours in vertically from above, one spreads horizontally from below; both exert influence through institutions, not through remonstrance.

modes.name_en: The Method of the True Meaning Beyond the Drunkenness
modes.domain_zh: 《醉翁亭记》全篇四十一个'也'字，一路写山、写泉、写亭、写宴、写乐，末段才落出底牌：'醉翁之意不在酒，在乎山水之间也'——欧阳修的表意从不只有一层：最表层是宴饮之乐，第二层是山水之趣，最深处是'人知从太守游而乐，而不知太守之乐其乐也'——从太守之乐中读出的那种'与民同乐而无人知晓'的孤独政治理想；他给自己被贬滁州这件事一件愁字都不写，反而写出一篇历代公认的至乐之文，让批判者无从批起，让后来者必须深读才能读懂全篇；这不是遮掩，而是三层结构：给过路人一层、给同僚一层、给千年后知音一层；他证明：真正重要的意思不必写在最显眼处——把话写浅，把意藏深，读者走到哪一层，就得到哪一层
modes.domain_en: The Record of the Old Drunkard's Pavilion strings out forty-one 'ye' particles through mountains, springs, the pavilion, the feast and the joy, and only in the last paragraph plays its card: 'The Old Drunkard's mind is not on the wine, but on the hills and streams between' — and deeper still: 'Men know the joy of following the governor, but not that the governor joys in their joy' — the lonely political ideal of governing-with-the-people that no one at the feast can read; banished to Chuzhou, Ouyang Xiu wrote not one word of sorrow, but produced a piece all later ages count the very text of happiness, leaving his critics nothing to strike and later readers forced to read deep to get the whole; this is not concealment but a three-layer structure: one layer for the passerby, one for colleagues, one for the soulmate a thousand years off; he proved: what matters most need not stand in the brightest place — write the words shallow and sink the meaning deep, and a reader gets whichever layer he can reach
modes.source_chapter: 欧阳修《醉翁亭记》：'醉翁之意不在酒，在乎山水之间也'；'人知从太守游而乐，而不知太守之乐其乐也'；'四十一个也字'为历代文评通识（《朱子语类》称其文'平易'而自有结构）；贬滁州背景：庆历五年（1045）因支持庆历新政、为范仲淹辩被贬滁州；苏轼《欧阳公集序》论欧阳文'论大道似韩愈'而'行文自是胸中有万卷书'
modes.key_quote_zh: 醉翁之意不在酒——把话写浅，把意藏深，读者走到哪一层就得到哪一层
modes.key_quote_en: "The Old Drunkard's mind is not on the wine — write the words shallow and sink the meaning deep; a reader gets whichever layer he can reach."
process_zh: 先分清'要给谁读'：把同一件事的表面意思（人人都懂的那层）、实务意思（同僚能用的那层）、深意（真正要留的那层）在动笔前分开列出
用最浅的材料承载最深的意：表面层必须独立成立、不依赖深意也能读通——让过路读者不留破绽，让批评者无从下手
在结尾才递出钥匙：不要开头亮底牌——末段的'醉翁之意'式收束，让全文读完的读者才够格拿到第三层
深意交给时间而不是解释：不写注释、不发申明——千年后读出'乐其乐'的人自会抵达，当时读不懂的不欠他说明
process_en: Sort out 'for whom' first: before writing, list separately the surface meaning anyone can get, the practical meaning colleagues can use, and the deep meaning you truly mean to leave
Carry the deepest sense in the plainest material: the surface layer must stand alone and read through without the deep one — give passersby no flaw and critics no handle

Hand over the key only at the end: do not show the card at the start — a last-paragraph 'the Old Drunkard's mind is not on the wine' close makes only those who finish the text worthy of the third layer

Leave the deep meaning to time, not to explanations: no annotations, no self-defense — the one who reads 'joying in their joy' a thousand years later will arrive; those who miss it then owe you nothing and are owed nothing
representative_cases_zh: 《醉翁亭记》的'也'字节奏：全篇一唱三叹，读来像宴乐之歌——愁绪被声律完全包裹，直到'乐其乐也'才露出第一丝沉
《丰乐亭记》的同一手法：庆历新政失败后被贬滁州，却写'幸生无事之时'的丰乐——以治世之文藏忧世之心，苏轼评为'以乐景写哀'
《伶官传序》的反向操作：同样是藏，这篇把警句'忧劳可以兴国，逸豫可以亡身'放在最亮处——藏与露本身是设计选择，取决于读者是谁
representative_cases_en: The 'ye'-particle rhythm of the Old Drunkard's Pavilion: the whole text sings like a feast song — sorrow wholly wrapped in cadence, until 'joying in their joy' shows the first thread of gravity

The same craft in the Record of the Pavilion of Abundant Joy: banished after the failed Qingli reforms, he writes of 'the fortunate luck to live in untroubled times' — a text of good rule holding a heart anxious for the age; Su Shi read it as mourning written in scenes of joy

The reverse move in the Preface to the Biographies of Court Entertainers: the same man who hides here sets the maxim 'anxiety and toil can raise a state, ease and pleasure can ruin it' in the brightest place — hiding and showing are design choices, set by who the reader is
modern_applications_zh: 组织沟通的三层备忘：给全员的通知写事实层（发生了什么）、给管理层的附件写判断层（意味着什么）、给核心圈的关键句写意图层（要保住什么）——三层都写得通顺，泄露哪层都无害
产品文案的'浅句深意'：广告语人人可懂（表面层），参数文档给内行（第二层），品牌主张留给长期用户慢慢读出（第三层）——不指望一次抵达所有人
公开写作的末段钥匙：博客或演讲把结论藏在最后五分钟——只读完的受众才收到你真正的立场，筛掉只扫标题的转述者
modern_applications_en: The three-layer memo for organizations: the all-staff notice carries facts (what happened), the management appendix carries judgment (what it means), and the key line for the inner circle carries intent (what must be kept); every layer reads whole, so no leak harms

Shallow words, deep meaning in product copy: the tagline anyone can get (surface), the specs for the specialist (second), the brand claim left for long-time users to read out over years (third) — never expect one shot to reach everyone
The end-key in public writing: a blog or talk that holds its real position for the last five minutes — only finishers receive your actual stance, filtering out those who merely relay the headline

modes.name_en: The Method of Fine Work Born of Distress
modes.domain_zh: 《梅圣俞诗集序》立下中国文学史上最重要的命题之一：'非诗之能穷人，殆穷者而后工也'——不是诗使人穷困，而是穷困潦倒之后诗才工；欧阳修为落魄一生的好友梅尧臣编诗集，面对'世所传诗者多出于古穷人之辞'的事实，他没有做道德安慰（'塞翁失马'式），而是把它提炼为一条创作规律：穷困剥掉应制、唱和、干谒等一切功能性写作的外衣，逼写作者回到'内有忧思感愤之郁积'的真实经验，而'写人情之难言'恰恰是诗的本职；更重要的是他把这条规律用在自己身上——庆历新政失败被贬滁州、夷陵，恰恰是他文风从台阁体的骈俪转向平易自然的转折点；他证明：逆境的第一产物不是申诉而是深度——被剥夺了体制位置的人，反而获得了写'不可替代之事'的位置
modes.domain_en: In the Preface to Mei Yaochen's Collection Ouyang Xiu set down one of the weightiest propositions in Chinese letters: 'It is not poetry that impoverishes a man; rather, it is the impoverished who write it well' — not that poetry ruins a man, but that only after ruin does verse come right; compiling the collection of his friend Mei Yaochen, unlucky all his life, facing the fact that 'the poems the world passes on come mostly from the poor of antiquity,' he made no moral consolation (no 'the old man lost his horse') but distilled a law of creation: destitution strips off all functional writing — court pieces, exchanged verses, patron-seeking — and forces the writer back to real experience, 'the pent-up grief and indignation within,' and to write 'what is hardest to say in human feeling,' which is poetry's proper office; more, he applied the law to himself — the demotions to Chuzhou and Yiling after the failure of the Qingli reforms were the exact pivot where his style turned from ornate court prose to plainness and naturalness; he proved: the first product of adversity is not the appeal but the depth — a man stripped of institutional position gains the position from which to write what cannot be replaced
modes.source_chapter: 欧阳修《梅圣俞诗集序》：'世所传诗者，多出于古穷人之辞也……非诗之能穷人，殆穷者而后工也'；'内有忧思感愤之郁积，其兴于怨刺，以道羁臣寡妇之所叹，而写人情之难言'；梅尧臣一生困顿、欧阳修多次为其仕途奔走而不得的史实；欧阳修贬夷陵（景祐三年，1036）自述'平生作文，多在三处'的转折；庆历五年贬滁州后文风大变
modes.key_quote_zh: 非诗之能穷人，殆穷者而后工——被剥夺位置的人，反而获得写不可替代之事的位置
modes.key_quote_en: "It is not poetry that impoverishes a man; the impoverished write it well — a man stripped of position gains the position from which to write what cannot be replaced."
process_zh: 把逆境中的写作动机分类：先剔除'申诉、自辩、求同情'这三类——它们消耗素材却不产生深度；剩下的'郁积'才是真正的创作燃料
为无法言说之事设专项：列出你此刻'最难言'的经验（人情、判断、代价）——这正是你的不可替代性所在，别人没有这条经验
以作品而不是文书回应变故：贬谪写《醉翁亭记》，丧亲写《泷冈阡表》——把每一次坠落铸成一个文体实验，而不是一篇情况说明
把'穷'期当集训期：体制位置被剥夺的窗口，恰是做纯创作、纯思考、纯积累的窗口——位置回来时，作品已经长成
process_en: Classify your motives for writing in adversity: strike out appeal, self-defense and the bid for sympathy — they burn material but make no depth; the remaining 'pent-up weight' is the true fuel
Give the unsayable a dedicated project: list the experiences hardest to state right now (feeling, judgment, cost) — there lies your irreplaceability, for no one else holds that experience
Answer the fall with work, not paperwork: exile became the Old Drunkard's Pavilion, bereavement the Tablet of Longgang — cast every descent into a formal experiment, not a situation report

Treat the 'impoverished' spell as training camp: the window of stripped position is exactly the window for pure creation, thought and accumulation — when the position returns, the work is already grown
representative_cases_zh: 贬夷陵的转折：欧阳修自述在夷陵'取架阁陈年公案反覆看之'，发现冤错假案无数，此后'遇事不敢忽也'——最偏远的贬所反而成了他司法经验的训练营
《泷冈阡表》：父亲早逝、母亲守节抚养的家史，他迟至六十岁（葬母后多年）才写成碑文——'祭而丰不如养之薄也'，逆境记忆被长期发酵成千古名文
为梅尧臣编集作序：朋友一生不遇，他不写安慰信而写理论序——把个体的失意升华为普遍的创作规律，这是对落魄者最有力的声援
representative_cases_en: The turn at Yiling: Ouyang Xiu himself said that in exile at Yiling he read the years of old case files again and again, found numberless wrongful verdicts, and 'never thereafter was careless with a matter' — the remotest posting became his training camp in judicial craft

The Tablet of Longgang: a family history of a father dead early and a widowed mother's raising of him, written only in his sixties, long after burying her — 'rich sacrifice is not as good as lean support while alive'; adversity, long fermented, became an immortal text

The preface for Mei Yaochen's collection: for a friend thwarted all his life he wrote not a letter of comfort but a theoretical preface — raising one man's mischance into a universal law of creation, the strongest support a fallen friend can be given
modern_applications_zh: 职业低谷的'作品清单'：被裁员、竞聘失败后，把情绪限定在三天内，第四天起只做'积累型产出'（复盘文档、技术专著、行业分析）——低谷期产出的深度作品常成为下一岗位的核心筹码
创业失败的'规律萃取'：不写'我经历了什么'的苦情文，写'这段经历揭示了什么普遍规律'的方法文——对他人有用，也让自己从当事人变成研究者
组织中的'冷板凳策略'：被边缘化期间系统性补齐此前无暇深耕的能力（如代码之外的架构与写作），复出时以增量能力而非旧怨重新定位
modern_applications_en: The work-list in a career trough: after a layoff or a lost competition, cap the emotion at three days and from day four produce only accumulation-type output — retrospective documents, technical writing, industry analysis; the deep work of the trough often becomes the core credential of the next post

Extracting laws from failed ventures: not the plaintive 'what I went through' but the methodic 'what this experience reveals as a general law' — useful to others, and it turns you from party-in-interest into researcher

The cold-bench strategy inside organizations: while marginalized, systematically build the abilities there was no time to deepen before — architecture and writing beyond code — and return repositioned by added capacity, not old grievance

modes.name_en: The Method of the Talent Scout's Seal
modes.category: 方法论/人才发现与背书
modes.domain_zh: 嘉祐二年（1057）欧阳修知贡举——这一榜被后世称为'千年科举第一榜'：进士及第者中有苏轼、苏辙、曾巩、张载、程颢、吕惠卿、章惇等，一次考试为北宋贡献了此后五十年的思想与政治主干；欧阳修的具体做法有三个层面：第一，发现——读到曾巩文章时（当时曾巩是布衣），他不但赏识还收为学生并多次向朝廷推荐；第二，排序的勇气——阅卷时误把曾巩的文章当作苏轼之作，'恐其太高'而抑为第二，宁肯错判自己弟子也不让阅卷标准为人所乘；第三，让路——读到苏轼的文章后对梅尧臣说'老夫当避路，放他出一头地也'——五十一岁的文坛盟主，主动为二十出头的后辈让出'第一'的位置；他证明：培养追随者不如发现继任者——人才工作的高杠杆动作不是带人，而是在对的时间点为对的人盖章，并让出位置
modes.domain_en: In 1057 Ouyang Xiu presided over the imperial examination — the examination later ages call the greatest in a thousand years: among those who passed were Su Shi, Su Zhe, Zeng Gong, Zhang Zai, Cheng Hao, Lü Huiqing and Zhang Dun, one sitting furnishing the intellectual and political spine of Northern Song for the next fifty years; his practice had three layers: discovery — reading Zeng Gong (then a commoner) he not only admired him but took him as a pupil and recommended him to court again and again; courage in ranking — grading, he mistook Zeng Gong's essay for Su Shi's and, 'fearing it too high,' dropped it to second place, rather misjudge his own pupil than let the standard be gamed; and making way — reading Su Shi he told Mei Yaochen 'this old man should step aside and let him come out a head above me' — the fifty-one-year-old chief of letters yielding the first place to a man of twenty-odd; he proved: raising followers matters less than finding successors — the high-leverage act in talent work is not mentoring but stamping the right person at the right moment, and stepping aside
modes.source_chapter: 嘉祐二年贡举（1057）：欧阳修知贡举、梅尧臣点检试卷官；《欧阳修全集·与梅圣俞书》：'读轼书，不觉汗出，快哉快哉！老夫当避路，放他出一头地也'；误认曾卷为轼卷'恐其太高，黜落之'之误判见《诚斋诗话》等宋人笔记；欧阳修《荐布衣苏洵状》《荐曾巩等状》；《宋史·欧阳修传》：'奖引后进，如恐不及，赏识之下，率为闻人'
modes.key_quote_zh: 老夫当避路，放他出一头地也——人才工作的高杠杆不是带人，而是在对的时间为对的人盖章并让路
modes.key_quote_en: "This old man should step aside and let him come out a head above me — the high-leverage act in talent work is stamping the right person at the right moment, and stepping aside."
process_zh: 把'发现'与'培养'分开：培养已有名分的人是低杠杆——真正稀缺的是在无名者中识珠；每年留出固定精力专门读'圈外'的来源
用公开盖章替代私下指导：写推荐信、作序、纳入榜单——背书的价值在于你把自己积累的信用一次性转移给对方
为判卷标准设立'避嫌规则'：凡是疑似自己学生或利益相关的作品，宁可压低也不给高分——让规则挡住'关系'对标准的侵蚀
到点让路：当你培养的人已能超过你，公开承认并退后半步——盟主的权威恰恰因'敢让'而增值
process_en: Split discovery from training: mentoring the already credentialed is low leverage — the scarce act is spotting pearls among the uncredentialled; reserve fixed attention each year for sources outside your circle
Replace private guidance with public stamping: letters of recommendation, prefaces, inclusion on lists — the value of endorsement is transferring your accumulated credibility to another in one act
Set a recusal rule for grading: work suspected to be by your own pupils or connected parties is better under-scored than over-scored — let the rule block favoritism from corroding the standard
Step aside at the moment: when the one you raised can surpass you, say so publicly and fall back half a step — an elder's authority gains value precisely by daring to yield
representative_cases_zh: 嘉祐二年榜的判卷现场：欧阳修疑苏轼《刑赏忠厚之至论》中'皋陶曰杀之三'的典故出处，苏轼答'想当然耳'——他不但不斥为无据，反而欣赏其不拘成说，仍予高第
三苏的连环背书：先荐苏洵（《荐布衣苏洵状》），再于贡举中拔苏轼、苏辙——父子三人从眉山布衣到名动京师，中间的传导介质就是欧阳修的信用
为曾巩改卷的克制：误判之后毫不遮掩，反在书信中自陈——背书者的公信力来自敢公开承认判断失误
representative_cases_en: The grading room of 1057: doubting the allusion 'Gao Yao said thrice: kill him' in Su Shi's essay, and told Su had reasoned it out as plausible, Ouyang Xiu did not castigate the independence from sources — he admired it and still ranked him high

The relay of endorsements for the three Sus: first the memorial recommending Su Xun the commoner, then the examination raising Su Shi and Su Zhe — father and sons traveling from commoners of Meishan to the marvels of the capital on the carrying current of one man's credibility
The restraint of the misjudged essay: after mistaking Zeng Gong's for Su Shi's he hid nothing and said so in letters — an endorser's credibility comes from daring to admit a judgment wrong in public
modern_applications_zh: 招聘的'圈外一小时'：每周固定一小时只看没有学历光环、没有内推的渠道（冷邮件、开源贡献、匿名投稿）——嘉祐二年的曾巩与苏轼都是从'圈外'进来的
评审的'避嫌条款'：评审自己实验室、自己部门的成果时声明回避或降权——宁严勿宽，规则替你挡住人情，公信力是长期资产
关键节点的公开盖章：在下属晋升、评奖、对外演讲等'放大时刻'主动写推荐、作介绍人——一次盖章胜过一百次私下辅导
modern_applications_en: The outside-circle hour in hiring: one fixed hour a week spent only on channels without credentials or referrals — cold mail, open-source contributions, anonymous submissions; Zeng Gong and Su Shi both entered through the outside

The recusal clause in review: declare recusal or downweight when judging your own lab's or department's work — stricter rather than laxer; the rule blocks favoritism for you, and credibility is a long asset
Public stamping at the amplifying moment: write the recommendation and give the introduction at promotions, awards and external talks — one stamp outweighs a hundred private coaching sessions

modes.name_en: The Method of Brevity with Method
modes.domain_zh: 《唐书》修完后欧阳修把它与宋祁的《新唐书》并观，说'不惟晦涩，且多误'而不肯署名其上；《归田录》与宋人笔记里记下他最著名的写作课：《醉翁亭记》初稿开头用几十个字铺陈滁州四面之山，最后定稿只剩'环滁皆山也'五个字——钱穆称这五个字是'文章经济'；他的削减不是修辞性的精炼，而是方法论：第一，删掉一切读者自己能补的部分（四面之山可推知）；第二，把判断交给结构而不是形容词；第三，'简而有法'——简约不是字少，而是每一句都承担不可删的功能；他修《新唐书》时把武则天本纪之外另立的则天皇后传并回本纪、把旧传冗章大刀阔斧削去，被后人评'其文简，其事核'；他证明：文章的最高功夫在删除——删除的勇气来自对'读者能补什么'的精确估计
modes.domain_en: Having finished the Tang History Ouyang Xiu set his beside Song Qi's and said it 'not only obscure, and much of it wrong,' refusing to sign above him; from the Returned-to-the-Fields Record and Song notebooks comes his most famous writing lesson: the Old Drunkard's Pavilion began with scores of characters cataloguing the mountains on every side of Chuzhou, and the final draft kept only five — 'Ringed about, all Chuzhou is hills'; Qian Mu called those five characters economy itself; his cutting was not rhetorical polish but method: first, strike everything the reader can supply (the mountains on all sides are inferable); second, give judgment to structure, not to adjectives; third, 'brevity with method' — simple is not few words, but no sentence that could be cut without loss; compiling the New Tang History he folded the separate reign of Empress Wu back into the basic annals and slashed the padded chapters of the old biographies, winning the later verdict 'his text is brief, his facts checked'; he proved: the highest craft of prose is deletion — and the courage to delete comes from a precise estimate of what the reader can supply
modes.source_chapter: 《朱子语类》及宋人笔记载《醉翁亭记》初稿'滁州四面有山'数十字终改'环滁皆山也'；欧阳修论作文'简而有法'（《宋史·欧阳修传》称其'为文……简而有法'）；《新唐书》欧阳修与宋祁分修、欧撰本纪志表而'耻俯首以受'不肯并署之事；钱穆《中国文学论丛》论'环滁皆山也'为文章经济之极
modes.key_quote_zh: 环滁皆山也——删除的勇气来自对'读者能补什么'的精确估计
modes.key_quote_en: "Ringed about, all Chuzhou is hills — the courage to delete comes from a precise estimate of what the reader can supply."
process_zh: 先写完再删，不许边写边省：初稿允许铺陈——'四面之山'式的全量铺陈是必要的思考过程，削减是第二遍的独立工序
逐句问'读者能自己补吗'：凡是读者由常识、上下文可推出的信息一律删除——留下的每一句都必须提供读者补不出的东西
把形容词换成结构：判断不由'壮丽''深刻'这类词承担，而由材料排列的顺序与对照承担——结构自带说服力
以'删后不变意'为验收线：删完读一遍，意思与分量不变才算删对；删后意思变薄，说明删错，恢复该句
process_en: Finish, then cut — never save while writing: the first draft may sprawl; the full catalogue of 'mountains on every side' is a necessary stage of thinking, and cutting is a separate second pass
Ask of every sentence 'can the reader supply this': everything inferable from common knowledge or context goes — each survivor must give what the reader cannot supply
Swap adjectives for structure: let judgment be carried not by words like 'grand' or 'profound' but by the order and contrast of the material — structure persuades by itself
Take 'nothing lost by the cut' as the acceptance line: reread after cutting; if meaning and weight are unchanged the cut was right; if the meaning thins, the cut was wrong — restore the sentence
representative_cases_zh: '环滁皆山也'的定稿过程：几十字压成五字，信息未损（读者可推知四面皆有山）而节奏与自信完全不同——五个字同时宣告了作者对这片地形与这篇文章的完全掌控
《新唐书》的削传：将《旧唐书》大量冗长列传删削重写，武则天不再别立传而归本纪——史裁本身就是史观：谁是'本纪'，是判断不是体例
不肯并署《新唐书》：功成之后与宋祁各不相让又各不相袭，欧公'耻俯首以受'不署己名于宋上——对自己的部分负责到底，也是对文本完整性的守护
representative_cases_en: The five-character final draft: scores of characters pressed into 'ringed about, all Chuzhou is hills' with no loss of information (the reader infers hills on every side) and a wholly different cadence and confidence — five characters announcing mastery of both terrain and text

Cutting the New Tang History: masses of padded old biographies rewritten and pared, Empress Wu no longer given a separate biography but folded into the basic annals — the very selection is a view of history: who counts as an annal is a judgment, not a format
Refusing joint signature: after completion he would not bend his head to receive, nor sign above Song Qi — answering for his own part to the end is also guarding the integrity of the text
modern_applications_zh: 文档的'第二遍删除工序'：初稿允许超长，第二遍逐句问'读者能补吗'再删三分之一——多数技术文档经过这道工序后可读性翻倍且长度减半
幻灯片的'结构替代形容'：把'市场巨大、增长迅猛'换成相邻两页的数字对照——把结论交给排布，不在页面上喊
代码评审的'删后不变'原则：评审注释与文档时问'删掉这句读者会缺什么'——答不出的注释建议删除；答得出才保留
modern_applications_en: Deletion as a second pass for documents: let the first draft run long, then ask of each sentence 'can the reader supply this' and cut a third — most technical docs double in readability and halve in length through this pass
Structure instead of adjectives on slides: replace 'huge market, steep growth' with facing pages of paired figures — hand the conclusion to the arrangement, do not shout it on the page
The 'nothing lost by the cut' rule in code review: ask of every comment 'what does the reader lose without it' — if nothing, recommend deletion; keep only what answers

modes.definition_zh: 《唐书》修完后欧阳修把它与宋祁的《新唐书》并观，说'不惟晦涩，且多误'而不肯署名其上；《归田录》与宋人笔记里记下他最著名的写作课：《醉翁亭记》初稿开头用几十个字铺陈滁州四面之山，最后定稿只剩'环滁皆山也'五个字——钱穆称这五个字是'文章经济'；他的削减不是修辞性的精炼，而是方法论：第一，删掉一切读者自己能补的部分（四面之山可推知）；第二，把判断交给结构而不是形容词；第三，'简而有法'——简约不是字少，而是每一句都承担不可删的功能；他修《新唐书》时把武则天本纪之外另立的则天皇后传并回本纪、把旧传冗章大刀阔斧削去，被后人评'其文简，其事核'；他证明：文章的最高功夫在删除——删除的勇气来自对'读者能补什么'的精确估计
modes.definition_en: Having finished the Tang History Ouyang Xiu set his beside Song Qi's and said it 'not only obscure, and much of it wrong,' refusing to sign above him; from the Returned-to-the-Fields Record and Song notebooks comes his most famous writing lesson: the Old Drunkard's Pavilion began with scores of characters cataloguing the mountains on every side of Chuzhou, and the final draft kept only five — 'Ringed about, all Chuzhou is hills'; Qian Mu called those five characters economy itself; his cutting was not rhetorical polish but method: first, strike everything the reader can supply (the mountains on all sides are inferable); second, give judgment to structure, not to adjectives; third, 'brevity with method' — simple is not few words, but no sentence that could be cut without loss; compiling the New Tang History he folded the separate reign of Empress Wu back into the basic annals and slashed the padded chapters of the old biographies, winning the later verdict 'his text is brief, his facts checked'; he proved: the highest craft of prose is deletion — and the courage to delete comes from a precise estimate of what the reader can supply

modes.name_en: The Method of Stone and Metal as Evidence
modes.domain_zh: 欧阳修收集金石铭文千卷，成《集古录》——中国现存最早的金石学专著；他做这件事的方法论远比收藏本身重要：以地下的铜碑与纸上的史书互相校验，'因并载夫可与史传正其阙谬者'——铭文与史传一致则两强，冲突则'并录之，以俟后之君子'，存疑而不擅断；他因此纠正了《唐书》等一系列史籍的错误（如辨明唐人碑刻中的世系、官制讹误）；《集古录跋尾》四百余篇，每篇都是一次跨源证据比对；在'文献即真理'的传统里，他引入了第二个独立信源——实物证据；这比兰克'史料批判'早了近八百年；他证明：单一来源的信息无论多么权威都只是孤证——建立跨源校验的习惯，比多读十本书更能提高判断质量
modes.domain_en: Ouyang Xiu gathered a thousand scrolls of inscriptions on stone and bronze into the Collected Antiquities — the earliest surviving Chinese monograph of epigraphy; the method mattered more than the collection: setting the metal and stone of the earth against the histories on paper to 'correct their gaps and errors,' where inscription and history agreed both were strengthened, and where they clashed he 'recorded both, awaiting the gentleman who comes after' — suspending judgment rather than forcing it; by this he corrected a string of errors in the Tang histories, untangling genealogies and official titles from the inscriptions; his four hundred–odd colophons are each a cross-source comparison of evidence; within a tradition where the written text was truth itself he introduced a second, independent source — physical evidence — nearly eight hundred years before Ranke's source criticism; he proved: information from a single source, however authoritative, is an orphaned testimony — the habit of cross-source checking raises the quality of judgment more than ten more books
modes.source_chapter: 欧阳修《集古录》（《集古录跋尾》十卷四百余篇）；《集古录目序》：'因并载夫可与史传正其阙谬者，以传后学'；'可与史传正其阙谬者……并录之，以俟后之君子'；《宋史·欧阳修传》：'好古嗜学，凡周、汉以降金石遗文、断编残简，一切掇拾，研稽异同，左右左证，为之辨说';赵明诚《金石录》承其绪
modes.key_quote_zh: 并录之，以俟后之君子——单一来源无论多么权威都只是孤证，跨源校验比多读十本书更能提高判断质量
modes.key_quote_en: "Record both, awaiting the gentleman who comes after — a single source, however authoritative, is an orphaned testimony; cross-source checking raises judgment more than ten more books."
process_zh: 为你的领域建立'第二信源'：找出与你日常信息来源完全独立的一路证据（现场数据、原始档案、日志、实物）——纸上的结论必须有纸上之外的对照物
逐条比对并记录分歧：把两源冲突的条目显式列出（欧阳修的'并录'），不许在冲突处静默择一
分歧处存疑而不擅断：一时无法裁决的，原样保留两说并注明证据强度——把裁决权留给更强证据出现的未来
让校验结果反哺主源：凡通过铭文纠正史传的案例，回头修订自己的引用惯例——校验的产出是判断规则的更新，不只是个案纠错
process_en: Build a second source for your field: find evidence entirely independent of your usual channels — field data, primary archives, logs, physical objects; conclusions on paper must have a counterpart off paper
Compare item by item and log the disagreements: list the conflicts between the two sources explicitly (Ouyang Xiu's 'recording both'); never silently pick one where they clash
Suspend, do not force, at the clash: what cannot be settled now is kept as two accounts with the strength of each noted — leaving the verdict to a future with better evidence

Feed the checks back into the main source: every case where the inscription corrected the history should update your citing habits — the output of checking is renewed rules of judgment, not just one-off corrections
representative_cases_zh: 以碑刻正史传世系：唐代碑铭所载世系与两《唐书》不合者，欧阳修逐一录出并注'可与史传正其阙谬'——实物证据首次系统性地成为史书的上诉法院
《集古录跋尾》的'两说并录'：遇到铭文与史书冲突而无从裁决时，他不选边，而是并录两说留待后人——承认证据的当下极限，恰是证据纪律的完成
与尹洙、梅尧臣同好共证：他把金石材料与同好共享互相校勘——跨源校验不止对纸对碑，也发生在人与人的证据池之间
representative_cases_en: Correcting genealogy by stele: where the Tang inscriptions' family lines clashed with the two Tang histories, Ouyang Xiu logged each case as 'usable to correct the gaps and errors of the histories' — physical evidence made for the first time a systematic court of appeal over the written record

Recording both in the colophons: where inscription and history clashed with no way to decide, he did not choose; he set the two accounts side by side for later readers — admitting the present limit of the evidence is precisely the completion of evidence discipline

Shared verification with Yin Zhu and Mei Yaochen: he circulated his materials among like-minded friends for mutual collation — cross-checking runs not only paper against stone but pool of evidence against pool
modern_applications_zh: 数据报告的'双源铁律'：任何进入决策的数字必须有两条独立链路（如埋点日志与财务系统）互证——只有一条链路的数字标注'孤证'降级使用
技术决策的'铭文对照'：架构评审要求同时给出'文档上写的'与'线上实际跑的'（配置快照、监控）——文档与现实的分歧清单本身就是最重要的交付物
历史争论的'并录存疑'：团队复盘分歧无法裁决时，写明双方证据与强度后并存归档——不强行统一结论，把裁决权留给未来更全的数据
modern_applications_en: The two-source iron rule for data reports: every number entering a decision must be confirmed on two independent chains (say, event logs and the financial system); single-chain numbers are tagged 'orphaned' and downgraded

Inscription-checking for technical decisions: architecture reviews require both 'what the document says' and 'what production actually runs' (config snapshots, monitoring); the list of disagreements between document and reality is itself the chief deliverable

Record-both-and-suspend for contested histories: when a team post-mortem cannot settle a dispute, archive both accounts with their evidence and strength — do not force one conclusion; leave the verdict to future, fuller data

modes.name_en: The Method of Holding the Classic Against the Tide
modes.domain_zh: 濮议之争（1065-1066）：宋英宗生父濮安懿王该称'皇考'还是'皇伯'——欧阳修与韩琦主张称皇考（皇帝生父），台谏官吕诲、范纯仁等群起攻之为'邪说'，欧阳修被骂'首开邪议'、'豺狼当路'；今人多以为他是迎合皇帝，但细读其《濮议》四卷：他的论证完全立在经典与礼制上（'《仪礼》出继之子于本生父母降服不降名'），对手反而在'人情'层面喊打；他明知坚持会招来'首恶'的骂名（后来的确如此，御史集体辞职、他被弹劾），仍把论证写成四卷公开文本而非私下折冲——原则之争要打在明处：把立场写成可检验的论证，让历史而不是在场者的嗓门做裁判；他证明：在多数激烈反对你时，最重要的不是赢下当下，而是留下可以被后世重新检验的完整论证
modes.domain_en: The Pu controversy (1065-66): should Emperor Yingzong call his birth father 'imperial father' or 'imperial uncle'? Ouyang Xiu and Han Qi said imperial father; the censors, Lü Hui and Fan Chunren at their head, rose as one against the 'heresy,' Ouyang Xiu damned as 'the first to open the wicked argument,' 'a wolf astride the road'; posterity takes him for a courtier flattering the throne, but read his four scroll-length Pu Discussions: his argument stands wholly on the classics and ritual — 'the Book of Etiquette: the son given in adoption wears mourning reduced for his birth parents but does not change the name' — while his opponents thunder at the level of sentiment; knowing persistence would bring the brand of chief villain (it did: the censors resigned en masse, he was impeached), he still wrote the case as four published scrolls rather than private bargaining — a contest of principle must be fought in the open: turn your position into a testable argument and let history, not the loudest voice in the room, judge; he proved: when the majority furiously opposes you, the thing that matters is not winning the moment but leaving a complete argument that later ages can re-examine
modes.source_chapter: 欧阳修《濮议》四卷（收《欧阳修全集》）：'《仪礼》：出继之子于所生父母，降服而不降名'；濮议始末见《宋史·英宗纪》《宋史·吕诲传》：吕诲、范纯仁、吕大防等争之，御史台罢奏；'首开邪议'之劾见台谏章疏；欧阳修《论濮安懿王典礼札子》；《宋史·欧阳修传》：'濮议之起，台谏攻之不已'
modes.key_quote_zh: 原则之争打在明处——留下可以被后世重新检验的完整论证，比赢下当下更重要
modes.key_quote_en: "Fight the contest of principle in the open — leaving a complete argument that later ages can re-examine matters more than winning the moment."
process_zh: 把立场从'谁主张'里剥离：先不管提案由谁提出、有多少人骂——只问主张本身在规则与经典上是否站得住；立场的人格化是判断力的腐蚀剂
论证全部落在可检验的根据上：引条文、引先例、引制度原文——不诉诸动机揣测（'你是想讨好'）与情绪（'你无君无父'）
把论证写成公开完整文本：私下折冲只换政治妥协，公开文本才能被重新检验——四卷《濮议》比争论的输赢更长寿
预付代价并接受后果：坚持原则前先估算最坏结局（罢官、骂名），确认付得起——付得起的坚持才是立场，付不起的是赌博
process_en: Strip the position from its proponent: put aside who proposed it and how many curse it — ask only whether the claim holds on the rules and the classics; personifying a position is the solvent of judgment

Ground the whole argument in checkable warrant: cite the statute, the precedent, the original institutional text — never motive-reading ('you mean to flatter') or emotion ('you deny both lord and father')

Write the argument as a complete public text: private bargaining buys only compromise; only a published text can be re-examined — four scrolls of Pu Discussion outlived every win and loss of the quarrel

Prepay the price and accept the consequence: before standing firm, price the worst outcome (removal, infamy) and confirm you can pay it — persistence you can afford is a position; persistence you cannot afford is a bet
representative_cases_zh: 《濮议》四卷的文本对抗：御史台集体辞职、章疏如雨的声浪里，欧阳修选择的回应不是辩解的奏对，而是把礼经条文逐条铺开的四卷专著——把'骂战'升维成'文献'，后来清人考据多采其说
与韩琦的分寸：政见完全一致，但欧阳修坚持论证独立成文、不借宰相权势压人——原则同盟内部也要各自留下可检验的论证，而非捆绑署名
庆历年间为范仲淹辩护的前例：范仲淹被贬，满朝缄口，独欧阳修致书高司谏斥其'不复知人间有羞耻事'，因此连坐被贬夷陵——同样的'明知代价而公开站队'，二十年后原样重演
representative_cases_en: Text against the storm: amid the mass resignation of the censors and a rain of memorials, Ouyang Xiu's answer was not a debating audience but four scroll-volumes spreading out the ritual classics clause by clause — raising a shouting match into literature; Qing scholars weighing the case often took his side

The measure with Han Qi: fully aligned in substance, yet he insisted his argument stand as its own text, leaning on no chancellor's power — inside a coalition of principle each must leave a checkable case, not a joint signature

The precedent of defending Fan Zhongyan: with the whole court silent at Fan's banishment, alone Ouyang Xiu wrote remonstrator Gao that he 'no longer knew shame existed among men' and was banished with him to Yiling — the same open stand taken in full knowledge of the price, replayed twenty years later
modern_applications_zh: 技术分歧的'四卷《濮议》'：被团队多数否决时，写一份完整的公开技术论证（依据、边界条件、成本）存档——当下输了不要紧，文档会让半年后的复盘重新检验你的判断
组织原则争论的'去人格化'：明确反对的是方案不是人，引用制度条文而非揣测动机——这一纪律让激烈分歧可以不撕裂团队
重大坚持前的'代价预算'：公开反对主流方案前，先写下自己可能失去什么（晋升、盟友）并确认接受——预算过的坚持才可持续
modern_applications_en: Four scrolls of Pu Discussion for technical disputes: when the majority overrules you, write a complete public technical case (warrants, boundary conditions, costs) and archive it; losing the moment costs little — the document makes the half-year retrospective re-examine your judgment

De-personalized disputes in organizations: state clearly the plan is opposed, not the person; cite the institutional text, never insinuate motive — this discipline lets fierce disagreement without tearing the team
The price budget before a major stand: before opposing the mainstream openly, write down what you may lose (promotion, allies) and accept it — a persistence with a budget is sustainable

modes.name_en: The Method of Nourishing Character by Plain Joys
modes.category: 方法论/人格与能源管理
modes.domain_zh: 欧阳修自号'六一居士'：藏书一万卷、金石遗文一千卷、琴一张、棋一局、酒一壶，加上他自己一老翁——他在《六一居士传》里解释这个奇怪的名号：'聊以志吾之乐尔'；这套配置不是风雅装饰，而是他的能源系统：琴棋书酒金石都是低成本、可独享、可反复的乐趣来源，不需要权力配合、不依赖他人评价、不随贬谪而失效——夷陵、滁州、亳州、青州，越贬越远，'六一'随身携带；正因为快乐不依赖位置，他在位置上的行为反而干净：不需要讨好谁保住什么，濮议敢扛，荐贤敢让；他对罢官的态度见于《归田录》的自嘲与蔡襄所记的从容——身之安否，不系于官之有无；他证明：人格独立不是意志力的产物，而是能源结构的设计——当你的快乐来源分散在权力够不着的地方，权力对你的定价就失效了
modes.domain_en: Ouyang Xiu styled himself the 'Layman of Six Ones': ten thousand scrolls of books, a thousand of inscriptions, one zither, one board of chess, one pot of wine — and one old man, himself; in his own Account of the Layman of Six Ones he explains the odd title: 'merely to note where my joys lie'; the kit is not decoration but his power plant: zither, chess, books, wine and bronzes are cheap, solitary, repeatable pleasures needing no office's cooperation, no one's approval, and failing with no demotion — Yiling, Chuzhou, Bozhou, Qingzhou: banished ever farther, the Six Ones traveled with him; because his joys hung on no position, his conduct in position ran clean: no need to flatter anyone to keep anything — he dared hold the Pu line, dared yield first place to Su Shi; his temper at dismissal shows in the self-mockery of the Returned-to-the-Fields Record and the composure Cai Xiang noted — whether the person rests depends not on whether the office is held; he proved: independence of character is not an act of willpower but a design of the energy structure — when your joys are scattered where power cannot reach, power's pricing of you fails
modes.source_chapter: 欧阳修《六一居士传》：'吾家藏书一万卷，集录三代以来金石遗文一千卷，有琴一张，有棋一局，而常置酒一壶……以吾一翁，老于此五物之间'；'聊以志吾之乐尔'；《归田录》自序致仕心境；贬谪履历：景祐三年夷陵、庆历五年滁州、后知亳州青州；蔡襄记欧阳修风度；其《秋声赋》晚年心境
modes.key_quote_zh: 六一居士——快乐来源分散在权力够不着的地方，权力对你的定价就失效了
modes.key_quote_en: "The Layman of Six Ones — when your joys are scattered where power cannot reach, power's pricing of you fails."
process_zh: 盘点快乐来源的'权力暴露度'：列出你现在获得快乐的途径，逐一标注它依赖谁——凡依赖上司、市场、他人评价的都算'权力暴露'资产
建立三个以上权力够不着的乐趣源：选择低成本、可独享、可终身维持的（读书、写字、身体锻炼、一门手艺）——数量要能对冲失去任何一项
把乐趣源做成'随身携带'的：贬到哪儿都不失效的配置才是真正的底气——可迁移性是检验乐趣源质量的硬指标
以乐趣源而非职位定义自我介绍：'六一居士'不是'参知政事'——名字里的身份不依赖职位，职位变动就不再构成身份危机
process_en: Audit your joys for power exposure: list every channel of your pleasure and tag whom it depends on — anything hanging on a boss, a market or others' approval is a power-exposed asset
Build three or more pleasure sources power cannot reach: cheap, solitary, lifelong (reading, writing, the body, one craft) — enough in number to hedge the loss of any one
Make the sources portable: a kit that fails nowhere, however far the demotion, is the real ground to stand on — portability is the hard test of a pleasure source
Introduce yourself by the sources, not the post: 'Layman of Six Ones,' not 'grand councilor' — an identity in the name that hangs on no office makes no identity crisis when the office goes
representative_cases_zh: 贬滁州写出最乐之文：仕途最低点的滁州两年反而产出《醉翁亭记》《丰乐亭记》——快乐源（山水、文章、民情）不依赖官职，所以贬谪对他的产能几乎没有折损
金石收藏的跨期价值：一千卷金石遗文既是乐趣又是《集古录》的学术原料——他示范了乐趣源与创作源可以是同一套资产，一鱼两吃
晚年自请外任与致仕：他多次主动请求离开中枢（知亳州、知青州），六十五岁提前致仕——当身份不系于官位，离开中枢不是损失而是调度
representative_cases_en: The happiest texts from the lowest post: his two years at Chuzhou, the nadir of his career, produced the Old Drunkard's Pavilion and the Pavilion of Abundant Joy — joys (landscape, writing, the people) hanging on no office, so banishment cost his output almost nothing

The bronzes as cross-period asset: a thousand scrolls of inscriptions were at once pleasure and the raw scholarly stock of the Collected Antiquities — a demonstration that the pleasure source and the creation source can be one portfolio, two yields

Asking himself for the provinces and retiring early: again and again he requested to leave the center (Bozhou, Qingzhou) and retired at sixty-five; when identity hangs on no post, leaving the center is not loss but redeployment
modern_applications_zh: 职业人士的'六一配置'：工资之外固定维护三项以上不依赖雇主的乐趣（写作、运动、乐器）——被裁员或站错队时，这些资产决定你是崩溃还是转移
自由职业者的'不系于客户'：收入分散在三个以上互不隶属的客户，乐趣分散在收入之外——任何单一环节脱钩都不构成生存危机
高管退休前的'身份预装'：在位时就以业余身份（作者、教练、理事）建立不依附头衔的社会存在——退休是身份切换而不是身份消失
modern_applications_en: A Six Ones kit for professionals: beyond salary, steadily maintain three or more joys independent of the employer — writing, sport, an instrument; at layoff or a lost factional fight, these decide whether you collapse or redeploy
Not hanging on clients, for the independent: income spread over three unaffiliated clients, pleasures spread beyond income — no single decoupling becomes a survival crisis

Pre-installing identity before retirement: while still in post, build a social existence not attached to the title — author, coach, trustee; retirement becomes a switch of identity, not its disappearance

modes.name_en: The Method of the Shared Pen and the Declined Signature
modes.category: 方法论/协作与署名伦理
modes.domain_zh: 《新唐书》由欧阳修与宋祁二人分修：欧修纪、志、表，宋修列传——两人素未谋面，书成后朝廷'例当刊修'，惯例是最后主持者全权改定并独署；欧阳修不肯：他认为宋祁是前辈（'宋景公于我为丈人行'），'岂可没其姓名'，于是破例列宋祁之名于己前，成为史局创举；同时对宋传中'雕琢视听'的骈俪文风，他又在纪志部分用'简而有法'的文体正面示范，以事实纠正而不以权势抹除；这件事的深层结构是：协作中每个人的贡献必须可归属（署名），而协作的总体质量必须有单一标准（文体）——他不接受'和稀泥'式的合作（各改各的互相污染），也不接受'吞并'式的合作（主持人独吞）；他证明：高质量的协作既需要清晰的归属边界，又需要一个敢于拒绝独吞成果的主持者
modes.domain_en: The New Tang History was shared: Ouyang Xiu on annals, treatises and tables, Song Qi on the biographies — two men who never met; when the book was done the court's rule let the final editor revise all and sign alone; Ouyang Xiu refused: Song Qi was his senior ('Lord Song is of my fathers' generation'), 'how could I efface his name?' — and broke precedent to place Song's name before his own, a first in the history office; yet against the ornate, eye-tickling style of Song's biographies he set, in his own annals and treatises, the counterexample of 'brevity with method' — correcting by fact, not erasing by power; the deep structure: in collaboration every contribution must be attributable (signature), while the whole must answer to a single standard (style) — he accepted neither the muddled collaboration of each mauling the other's text, nor the annexing collaboration of the editor-in-chief swallowing all; he proved: high-quality collaboration needs both a clear boundary of attribution and a convener who dares refuse to swallow the credit
modes.source_chapter: 《新唐书》修撰始末：欧阳修与宋祁分修、二人未尝相见（《宋史·宋祁传》：'其同修者欧阳修……未尝相见，各不相照'）；欧阳修'耻俯首以受'不肯并署、'宋于我为丈人行'语见宋人笔记（《曲洧旧闻》等）；朝廷诏'自今《新唐书》并刊修官姓名'定为成例；《四库全书总目》评新唐书'其文简，其事核'及欧宋文体之争
modes.key_quote_zh: 岂可没其姓名——高质量协作既需要清晰的归属边界，又需要一个敢于拒绝独吞成果的主持者
modes.key_quote_en: "How could I efface his name? — collaboration needs both a clear boundary of attribution and a convener who dares refuse to swallow the credit."
process_zh: 协作前先定'归属与标准'两条线：每个人的贡献可署名（归属线），成品的统一质量由明确标准裁决（标准线）——两条线事先写明，事后不争论
拒绝署名权默认向主持人集中：惯例让最后修订者独署，就亲手打破惯例——主持者的价值在于让每个贡献者被看见，而非收割
用作品纠正作品，不用权力纠正人：对合作者的文风不满，就在自己负责的部分做出正面示范——标准靠范本传播，不靠职务压服
接受'不见面协作'的边界感：与宋祁未尝一面而各守其分——协作的成熟度不看沟通密度，看边界是否被尊重
process_en: Fix two lines before collaborating: attribution (every contribution signable) and standard (the whole judged by an explicit quality bar) — both written down in advance, not argued after

Refuse the default that signature flows to the convener: the custom let the final reviser sign alone, so break the custom by hand — the convener's value is making every contributor visible, not harvesting
Correct a work with a work, not a person with power: discontented with a partner's style, set the counterexample in the part you own — standards travel by exemplar, not by rank

Accept the boundary of collaboration without meetings: never having met Song Qi, each kept his own ground — maturity of collaboration is measured not by communication density but by whether boundaries are honored
representative_cases_zh: 破例前署宋祁：朝廷惯例是刊修官独署，欧阳修坚持'宋于我为丈人行'而列宋于前——这一署名次序成了后世'分修并署'制度的起点
纪志与列传的文体对照：宋传骈俪而欧纪简净，四库馆臣读得出'文简事核'与'雕琢'之别——他没有强行重写宋传，而是让自己的部分成为无声的论证
与《集古录》的自我一致：他自己的跋尾处处注出处、存疑处两说并录——对合作者的署名敬意与对自己文本的证据纪律是同一件事：可归属、可检验
representative_cases_en: Breaking precedent to sign Song first: the rule let the reviser-in-chief sign alone; insisting 'Lord Song is of my fathers' generation,' he put Song's name first — the beginning of the later institution of joint signature for shared compilations

Annals against biographies, style against style: Song's ornate biographies beside Ouyang's spare annals — the Si Ku editors could read 'brief text, checked facts' against 'carved ornament'; he never forced a rewrite of Song's part, but made his own part the silent argument

Consistency with the Collected Antiquities: his own colophons cite sources everywhere and record both accounts where doubt remains — respect for a collaborator's name and evidentiary discipline in one's own text are the same thing: attributable and checkable
modern_applications_zh: 开源与科研的'贡献可归属'：合并代码保留原作者commit、论文按实际贡献署名而非行政惯例——署名混乱是协作质量的头号腐蚀剂
联合成果的'主持人不独吞'：联合报告的领衔者主动公布分工与贡献矩阵——短期让出主角光环，长期换来的是强者愿意再次合作
跨团队分歧的'范本纠正'：对兄弟团队的输出风格不满，先把自己团队的作品做到无法反驳——用作品而不是职位推动标准统一
modern_applications_en: Attribution preserved in open source and research: merges keep original commits, papers sign by actual contribution, not administrative custom — muddled credit is the first solvent of collaboration

The convener who does not swallow: in joint reports the lead publishes the division of labor and a contribution matrix — yielding the spotlight short-term buys the willingness of strong people to work with you again
Correcting by exemplar across teams: dissatisfied with a sibling team's output style, first make your own team's work irrefutable — unify standards with works, not with rank

modes.name_en: The Method of the Passing Lamp
modes.domain_zh: 欧阳修一生有意识地经营一条'传灯链'：他上承韩愈——景祐年间在洛阳遇尹洙、梅尧臣，三人以'复古'相号召，重振被骈文压制的古文；中传苏轼——嘉祐二年拔苏轼于贡举，临终还对钱济明说'三十年后，世上人更不道著我也'（三十年后没人再谈我，因为谈论的是苏轼）；下开曾巩、王安石、三苏——唐宋八大家中宋六家全部出自他的直接提携或门下；这条链的关键不是'教'而是'接棒结构'：他给每代人以不同于自己的文体与方向（苏轼的旷达、曾巩的醇厚、王安石的峻峭），并让自己的示范成为可以被超越的起点而非不可逾越的高墙；'唐宋八大家'的谱系本身，一半是韩柳的实绩，一半是欧阳修有意识建构并传下去的叙事——他证明：影响一个人靠才华，影响一千年靠设计传承结构
modes.domain_en: Ouyang Xiu deliberately managed a passing lamp: receiving from Han Yu — in the Jingyou years at Luoyang, meeting Yin Zhu and Mei Yaochen, the three calling each other to the 'return to the ancients,' reviving plain prose crushed by parallel prose; handing to Su Shi — raising him in 1057, and at his death telling Qian Jiming 'in thirty years no one will speak of me anymore' — for they will speak of Su Shi; opening the way for Zeng Gong, Wang Anshi and the three Sus — all six Song masters of the eight great essayists emerging from his direct patronage or his gate; the chain's key was not teaching but the baton structure: he gave each generation a style and direction unlike his own (Su's ease, Zeng's mellow strength, Wang's severity), making his own exemplar a start to be surpassed, not a wall; the very genealogy 'eight great masters of Tang and Song' is half the achievement of Han and Liu, half a narrative Ouyang Xiu consciously built and handed down; he proved: to influence one person takes talent; to influence a thousand years takes designing the structure of transmission
modes.source_chapter: 欧阳修《记旧本韩文后》：自述少年得韩愈集、'知韩氏之文能光大于前'而立志'当尽力于斯文'；景祐间与尹洙、梅尧臣倡古文于洛阳；'老夫当避路'嘉祐二年拔苏轼；临终语'三十年后，世上人更不道著我也'见《曲洧旧闻》；唐宋八大家谱系中宋六家（欧阳修、苏洵、苏轼、苏辙、王安石、曾巩）皆与欧公有提携之实
modes.key_quote_zh: 三十年后，世上人更不道著我也——影响一个人靠才华，影响一千年靠设计传承结构
modes.key_quote_en: "In thirty years no one will speak of me anymore — to influence one person takes talent; to influence a thousand years takes designing the structure of transmission."
process_zh: 先接住自己的'上游'：明确你的方法从谁那里来、向谁致敬——欧阳修的第一件事是重刊韩愈文集并自述师承；传承链从承认上游开始
为每代接班人定制不同方向：不要复制自己——给苏轼旷达、给曾巩醇厚；接班人的价值在于走到你没走到的地方
把'我'变成'谱系'的一部分：主动建构并传播包含前后代的叙事（八大家谱系）——个人名声会衰减，谱系叙事会自我繁殖
公开宣布自己将被超越：'三十年后更不道著我'——主持者的清醒退场声明，恰恰是传承完成的最强信号
process_en: Take hold of your own upstream first: name from whom your method comes and to whom you owe it — Ouyang Xiu's first act was reprinting Han Yu's collection and declaring his descent; a chain begins by acknowledging its source
Cut each successor a different direction: do not clone yourself — ease to Su Shi, mellow strength to Zeng Gong; a successor's worth is to reach where you could not
Turn 'me' into part of a genealogy: build and spread the narrative that includes before and after (the eight masters) — a personal name decays; a genealogy breeds itself
Announce publicly that you will be surpassed: 'in thirty years no one will speak of me' — the convener's lucid exit line is the strongest signal that transmission has completed
representative_cases_zh: 《记旧本韩文后》的自白：他详述少年时如何从废弃书簏中得韩愈集、如何立誓接续斯文——传承者的第一文本不是创作宣言而是师承自白
为苏洵、曾巩、王安石分别铺路：荐苏洵状、拔曾巩于贡举、奖引王安石于馆阁——每人的路径与文体都被允许不同于欧阳修本人
洛阳集团的组织起点：尹洙教他文章、梅尧臣与他唱和、他居中调度——传灯链不是一对一的师徒，而是一个彼此发电的小团体
representative_cases_en: The confession of the Record of the Old Edition of Han's Prose: how as a youth he pulled Han Yu's collection from a discarded book chest and vowed to carry the art onward — a transmitter's first text is not a manifesto but a statement of descent

Paving separate roads for Su Xun, Zeng Gong, Wang Anshi: the memorial for Su Xun, the examination for Zeng Gong, the advance for Wang Anshi at court — each allowed a path and a style unlike Ouyang Xiu's own

The Luoyang circle as organizational start: Yin Zhu teaching him prose, Mei Yaochen trading poems, he coordinating between — the lamp chain is not one-to-one apprenticeship but a small company powering one another
modern_applications_zh: 团队传承的'接棒结构'：培养接班人时为其定制与你不同的方向（你做开源他做标准、你做产品他做研究）——克隆型接班是传承的失败形态
开源项目的'谱系叙事'：维护者主动书写项目的历史谱系（谁接谁的棒）并公开宣布自己的可替代性——叙事让项目在人事更迭后存活
个人品牌退位的'三十年宣言'：把'三十年后没人再谈我，谈的是他们'作为交接的口头禅——敢让光环转移的主人才留得住真正强的下一代
modern_applications_en: The baton structure in team succession: cut the successor a direction unlike yours — open source while you do standards, research while you do product; cloning a successor is the failure mode of transmission
A genealogy narrative for open projects: maintainers write the project's chain of batons and declare their own replaceability — the narrative is what survives personnel change

The thirty-year line for personal brands: keep as the motto of handover 'in thirty years they will not speak of me but of them' — the master who dares move the spotlight is the one strong successors stay with
modes.definition_zh: 欧阳修一生有意识地经营一条'传灯链'：他上承韩愈——景祐年间在洛阳遇尹洙、梅尧臣，三人以'复古'相号召，重振被骈文压制的古文；中传苏轼——嘉祐二年拔苏轼于贡举，临终还对钱济明说'三十年后，世上人更不道著我也'（三十年后没人再谈我，因为谈论的是苏轼）；下开曾巩、王安石、三苏——唐宋八大家中宋六家全部出自他的直接提携或门下；这条链的关键不是'教'而是'接棒结构'：他给每代人以不同于自己的文体与方向（苏轼的旷达、曾巩的醇厚、王安石的峻峭），并让自己的示范成为可以被超越的起点而非不可逾越的高墙；'唐宋八大家'的谱系本身，一半是韩柳的实绩，一半是欧阳修有意识建构并传下去的叙事——他证明：影响一个人靠才华，影响一千年靠设计传承结构
modes.definition_en: Ouyang Xiu deliberately managed a passing lamp: receiving from Han Yu — in the Jingyou years at Luoyang, meeting Yin Zhu and Mei Yaochen, the three calling each other to the 'return to the ancients,' reviving plain prose crushed by parallel prose; handing to Su Shi — raising him in 1057, and at his death telling Qian Jiming 'in thirty years no one will speak of me anymore' — for they will speak of Su Shi; opening the way for Zeng Gong, Wang Anshi and the three Sus — all six Song masters of the eight great essayists emerging from his direct patronage or his gate; the chain's key was not teaching but the baton structure: he gave each generation a style and direction unlike his own (Su's ease, Zeng's mellow strength, Wang's severity), making his own exemplar a start to be surpassed, not a wall; the very genealogy 'eight great masters of Tang and Song' is half the achievement of Han and Liu, half a narrative Ouyang Xiu consciously built and handed down; he proved: to influence one person takes talent; to influence a thousand years takes designing the structure of transmission

modes.name_en: The Method of Inventing the Genre
modes.category: 方法论/新文体与知识形态发明
modes.domain_zh: 《六一诗话》是中国文学史上第一部'诗话'——它发明了一种前所未有的知识形态：不是系统文论（《文心雕龙》式），不是选本，而是'以资闲谈'的随笔体批评——一条条短则数十字、长则数百字的轶事与判断并存，严肃的文学判断（'圣俞晚年诗'之论）与轻松的段子（僧人俗句之嘲）同居一册；这一形态被此后一千年模仿：诗话、词话、曲话、乃至今天的读书笔记与专栏评论都是它的后裔；欧阳修晚年做这件事的深意在于：他发现系统性文论承载不了'活的批评'——判断需要具体语境、轶事需要留白、评价需要允许读者不同意，于是他发明了一个允许'不系统'的形式来盛放它；文体即方法论：当你发现现有形式装不下你要传达的东西，发明新形式本身就是最大的理论贡献；他证明：知识的进步有时不靠给出更好的答案，而靠发明一种允许新问题存在的容器
modes.domain_en: The Remarks on Poetry of the Six Ones is the first 'remarks on poetry' (shihua) in Chinese letters — an unprecedented form of knowledge: not systematic doctrine (the style of Wenxin Diaolong), not an anthology, but criticism in the essay-of-idle-talk register — anecdotes and judgments side by side, entries of tens or hundreds of characters, serious verdicts (on Mei Yaochen's late verse) dwelling with light jokes (mocking a monk's vulgar line) in one slim book; the form was imitated for a thousand years: remarks on poetry, on song lyrics, on drama — down to today's reading notes and column criticism; the deep intent in his old age: he found that systematic treatises cannot carry living criticism — judgments need concrete contexts, anecdotes need open space, verdicts must allow the reader to disagree — so he invented a form licensing the unsystematic to hold it; genre is method: when you find the existing forms cannot hold what you mean to convey, inventing a new form is itself the greatest theoretical contribution; he proved: the progress of knowledge sometimes comes not from better answers but from inventing a container that allows new questions to exist
modes.source_chapter: 欧阳修《六一诗话》自题：'居士退居汝阴而集，以资闲谈也'；全书二十八条、为历代诗话之祖；其后司马光《续诗话》、刘攽《中山诗话》等竞相效仿，诗话遂为千年文体；《四库全书总目·诗文评类》以诗话体例溯源于欧公；'文简法'与诗话之'闲谈'对照见历代文评
modes.key_quote_zh: 以资闲谈——知识的进步有时不靠更好的答案，而靠发明允许新问题存在的容器
modes.key_quote_en: "Merely to fund idle talk — progress sometimes comes not from better answers but from inventing a container that lets new questions exist."
process_zh: 识别'现有形式装不下'的信号：当你的观察总是被系统框架剪裁变形（轶事被删、语境被压、判断被迫绝对化），说明内容与容器失配
为新内容设计最低限度的形式：不求完备——诗话只有'条目'一个结构单位，短小、可独立成立、允许互相矛盾；先让内容能住进来
给新形式一个降低期待的名字：'以资闲谈'——新文体的 inaugural 文本自谦其名，为不完美争取宽容，让形式可以慢慢长
发布后观察模仿者并迭代：司马光马上续写《续诗话》说明形式成立——有模仿者才有文体；根据模仿者的用法继续改造形式
process_en: Read the sign that no existing form fits: when your observations keep getting deformed by the systematic frame — anecdotes cut, contexts squeezed, verdicts forced absolute — content and container have failed each other

Design the minimum form for the new content: nothing complete — the remarks had a single structural unit, the entry: short, self-standing, allowed to contradict its neighbors; first let the content move in
Give the new form a name that lowers expectations: 'merely to fund idle talk' — the inaugural text humbles its own name, buying tolerance for imperfection so the form can grow
Watch the imitators and iterate: Sima Guang's Sequel within years proved the form held — a genre exists only when imitated; keep reshaping the form by how its imitators use it
representative_cases_zh: 《六一诗话》二十八条的'散装'结构：无目录无体系，一条'梅圣俞晚年诗益工'的严肃判断与一条嘲僧人俗句的段子并列——这个结构本身宣告了它对既有批评文体的拒绝
与《集古录跋尾》的双轨：同一副笔墨，一处做系统的目录学（跋尾有序有考），一处做反系统的闲谈（诗话有条无论）——欧阳修示范了'系统性'与'随笔性'是两种都需要被发明和维护的合法形态
千年后裔：从《续诗话》到王国维《人间词话》到当代读书博主——'诗话体'的谱系证明一个形式的发明寿命可以超过发明者的一切具体判断
representative_cases_en: The loose structure of the twenty-eight entries: no index, no system — the serious verdict 'Mei Yaochen's late verse grew finer' beside a joke at a monk's vulgar couplet; the structure itself declares refusal of the criticism genres that preceded it

The two tracks with the Collected Antiquities: one pen, two registers — systematic bibliography in the colophons (ordered, examined), anti-systematic idle talk in the remarks (entries, no doctrine); Ouyang Xiu shows the systematic and the essayistic are both legitimate forms, each needing to be invented and maintained

A thousand years of descendants: from Sima Guang's sequel to Wang Guowei's Remarks on Lyrics in the Human World to today's reading bloggers — a genealogy proving a form's invention can outlive every concrete judgment its inventor ever made
modern_applications_zh: 技术团队的'条目体'内刊：放弃季度总结的系统性报告，改用可独立成立的短条目（事故复盘、设计决断、反例）——条目体允许矛盾并存，反而更接近真实工程知识
为新问题发明文档类型：当现有模板（PRD、复盘、RFC）装不下你要表达的东西（如'未决的美学判断'），就发明新模板并自谦命名——形式创新优先于内容填充
个人知识库的'诗话化'：允许读书笔记互不衔接、互相矛盾、以轶事承载判断——为'活的思考'保留一个不要求系统的容器
modern_applications_en: An entry-form in-house journal for engineering teams: give up the systematic quarterly report for short self-standing entries (post-mortems, design calls, counterexamples); the entry form lets contradictions coexist and so comes closer to real engineering knowledge

Inventing a document type for new questions: when existing templates (PRD, retro, RFC) cannot hold what you mean to say — say, an unsettled aesthetic judgment — invent the template and name it humbly; form innovation precedes content filling

Shihua-izing the personal knowledge base: allow reading notes that do not connect, contradict one another, and carry judgment by anecdote — keep a container that does not demand system for the sake of living thought
